source_message.text:
Hey,

The account is funded and I am ready to make this official. Welcome to the team.

Here is your confirmed offer:

**FLAT RETAINER: $400-500 per month**
For 100 approved clips per month. Approved means approved by me personally — if a clip does not meet the standard it does not count toward your monthly quota. Quality is everything here.

**YOUR INSTAGRAM ACCOUNT**
You will be assigned your own dedicated Instagram account. You post your approved clips directly to that account. Every clip is tracked — views, performance, engagement — full transparency at all times.

**PERFORMANCE BONUSES**
On top of your flat retainer, every clip that hits a view milestone earns you a bonus. The better your clips perform the more you earn on top of your base. This is your opportunity to earn well above the flat fee every single month.

**NEXT STEPS**
\- I will send you the official Upwork contract shortly
\- Once you accept you will receive your Instagram account login
\- You start posting immediately

This is real. This is long term. And this is just the beginning — the path to Lead Clipper and $2,000 per month is open to you from day one.

Let us build something great together.

Cleavon

Hey,

Welcome — you are one of only 2 clippers hired right now. That means you are in from the start and have a real opportunity to grow with this from day one.

Let me answer your questions:

**What videos you will be editing:**
Teyron Alexina's long-form YouTube videos. You watch them, find complete moments — a full lesson, a story, a real point — and turn each one into a standalone 45-60 second clip for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.

**Deadline for the 100 clips:**
100 approved clips per month. That breaks down to roughly 3-4 clips per day. Consistent daily output is what keeps you on track.

**On the payment:**
The retainer is $400-500 per month for 100 approved clips. Approved means I review and approve every clip personally — only approved clips count toward the 100. On top of that you earn performance bonuses based on how your clips perform on Instagram — up to $500 on a single clip that blows up. So your earning potential is well above the flat fee.

Tomorrow I will send you everything you need — the full training material, the guidelines, and your assigned Instagram account. Get ready.

This is just the beginning. Let us crush this.

Cleavon

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey team,

First, sorry for the delay lately. Upwork had us on hold and we couldn't move as fast as we wanted. That's sorted now, so we're back to full speed.

While we were on hold, I put together a new system to make your job easier and help you hit your 100 approved clips faster.

Here's what's new:

1\. Clip variations - you can now take the same body clip and change just the hook/opening to make a new version. You can reuse one clip up to 2-3 times this way. Less work, more clips.

2\. Shorter clip styles - these are quicker to make and easier to combine, so reaching 100 approved clips will be a lot smoother. Some of you could even push past 200 if you want.

3\. Hook training video - I'm making a video showing you how to find strong hooks. One long video can give you close to 50 clip ideas. This will make finding content faster and easier.

We see the work, loyalty, and commitment you've all put in, even with the delays on our end, and we appreciate it. This new system is to help you earn more without extra headaches.

Looking ahead, we want to build you up into Lead Clippers as we grow and bring more people onto the team. That starts with mastering this new approach.

More details and examples coming soon. Let's get back to it.

\- Cleavon

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I had to end the contract. With tomorrow being the 1-month mark and only 1 clip delivered, despite me reaching out 3 times, I wasn't left with another option. This isn't personal — I just have to hold the same standard for everyone on the team, and the milestones exist for a reason.

I'm sorry it ended this way. If circumstances were different on your end, I get that life happens — but I need clippers I can count on to communicate, even if it's just to say "I'm behind" or "I need more time."

Wishing you well with whatever's next. If you ever want to try again down the line and things look different for you, the door's not permanently closed.
